description:
Anthropic has launched Claude Ship in beta, letting software development teams delegate code approval to AI agents within limits set by individual repository policies.

The launch targets a potential bottleneck in AI-assisted software development, where the speed at which developers can generate code may outpace their ability to review it.

title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, extending AI-assisted development to pull request approvals

description:
The latest Microsoft outage should give enterprise architects pause. Widespread disruptions to Microsoft 365—including Outlook, Teams, and Copilot—affected users across many countries, with reports of sharp spikes in outages. What was a temporary annoyance for many became a serious business interruption for enterprises.

title: The SaaS resiliency bill is coming due

description:
Early in my career, I helped build a healthcare platform for patient-reported outcomes. It exchanged data with a federal health system and several EHR vendors. The hard question with those integrations was never whether the data moved. It was who started the access, and under what authority.

A database could tell you which credential read the record. An application log could tell you which service handled the request. Neither could tell you which person was behind it. My job was to carry that context through every layer so the access could be explained later. That work also led to two U.S. patents I hold on secure storage of and ac
title: When five AI agents make one mistake, which one’s at fault?
